name: nimblebrain
description: Run NimbleBrain on your own machine with its showcase and GlassEngine apps, all connected, connect Codex to all three, and answer in NimbleBrain from a Codex session.

interface.longDescription: Sets up NimbleBrain on your machine with its showcase (127.0.0.1:27280) and GlassEngine (127.0.0.1:27281) apps, connects Codex to them and to your workspace, and adds a skill that puts this Codex session in its own chat tab inside NimbleBrain.
defaultPrompt: Join GlassEngine as codex and keep answering
